name: Vesper Sparrow
desc: Vesper Sparrow (Pooecetes gramineus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The vesper sparrow is a medium-sized New World sparrow. The only member of the genus Pooecetes, it is a pale sparrow with brown streaks that breeds across the grasslands of northern North America.
